{{Top|leg}}
'''Plextech Plastic Corporation''' ('''PPC''') was a major company based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] and maintained by [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] funds. 

The heavy industrial plant, with hundreds of smoke tubes, was for practical reasons built far from the main [[city/Legends|city]] of the colony, near the [[Sesseranda Ocean]]. The city-sized complex was self-contained and housed a million of Bothans and half that number of [[droid/Legends|droids]]. 

They specialized in the creation of high-quality and low-cost raw [[plastic/Legends|plastic]] materials sold to the industries of [[Tal'cara]]. By the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], PPC was the largest corporation on the entire planet. 

The production of these materials by the gigantic plant, created large amounts of noxious waste and millions of [[Liter/Legends|liters]] of affluent, both of which are directed to the ocean. The area within a 50-[[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] radius of the factory became a total wasteland.
